title: Discussing availability for a part-time job
objectives: Explain why the job suits you
State clear weekday and weekend availability
Ask about training or the start date

courseTemplate.setting: The café needs weekend shifts. It offers two paid training shifts. The student is free on weekday mornings and weekends.

roles.learner: A student interviewing at a café

courseTemplate.openingLine: What made you apply to this café?

targetPatterns.pattern: I like the atmosphere, and morning shifts fit around my classes.
targetPatterns.example: I like the atmosphere, and morning shifts fit around my classes.

targetPatterns.pattern: I can work weekdays before eleven and on weekends.
targetPatterns.example: I can work weekdays before eleven and on weekends.

targetPatterns.pattern: That sounds good. When would I start training?
targetPatterns.example: That sounds good. When would I start training?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm looking for around 15 hours a week.
targetPatterns.example: I'm looking for around 15 hours a week.
targetPatterns.translation: 我想每周工作 15 小时左右。

targetPatterns.pattern: Do you sponsor student work permits?
targetPatterns.example: Do you sponsor student work permits?
targetPatterns.translation: 你们支持学生工作许可吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Can I swap shifts with someone?
targetPatterns.example: Can I swap shifts with someone?

targetPatterns.pattern: I need next Saturday off — is that possible?
targetPatterns.example: I need next Saturday off — is that possible?
targetPatterns.translation: 下周六我需要请假，可以吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: How does the tip system work here?
targetPatterns.example: How does the tip system work here?

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I get my payslip explained?
targetPatterns.example: Could I get my payslip explained?

stages.title: Explain why the job suits you
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “What made you apply to this café?”
successCriteria: The learner can explain why the job suits you in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I like the atmosphere, …”

stages.title: State clear weekday and weekend availability
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “When would you be available to work?”
successCriteria: The learner can state clear weekday and weekend availability in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I can work weekdays …”

stages.title: Ask about training or the start date
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Weekend cover would be great. We begin with two paid training shifts.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask about training or the start date in their own words.
hints: You can start with “That sounds good. When …”
